verdict.rationale: Rive lets authors define event-driven behavior inside content. Interactions respond to user input, scrolling, screen size and application state. State machines and data binding update the scene automatically when data changes, and scripting supports custom behaviors. This is rule-like triggering scoped to animation and interactive content, not general workflow automation. missing for 10: workflow-level automation rules (e.g. triggers on file or editor events, webhooks, or actions on external services), detailed docs on how event-to-action rules (listeners/transitions) are defined, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
